domains.name: Core Concepts and Architecture
objectives: 1.1 Describe the core components and architecture of a Cloud Cost Management (CCM) solution.
1.2 Explain how CCM integrates with other ServiceNow modules (e.g., CMDB, SAM, Discovery).

domains.name: Setup, Data Ingestion, and Configuration
objectives: 2.1 Identify prerequisites and steps for installing and configuring CCM, including role access.
2.2 Configure data ingestion pipelines and validate billing data from cloud providers.

domains.name: Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting
objectives: 3.1 Use dashboards and reports to analyze cloud spend and usage trends.
3.2 Apply forecasting and budgeting tools to support financial planning.

domains.name: Optimization and Governance
objectives: 4.1 Apply policies and automation to optimize cloud resource usage.
4.2 Implement governance strategies to ensure accountability and cost control.
